subject: Support stack sourcing — decision log and next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Support stack sourcing — initial alignment

Hi team,

Attaching the latest RFP (support_rfp_v2.pdf) and a draft vendor_scorecard.xlsx. We need to finalize our short list and negotiation approach for the CS/support tooling (Intercom/Gainsight bundles vs Zendesk + Gainsight). High-level constraints:

- Target annual spend: <$250k (goal), absolute cap $350k
- Must support SSO (SAML/SCIM), KMS-compatible key management for logs, and VPC peering for webhook delivery
- SOC2 + pen-test evidence required pre-sign
- Integrations: Segment, Datadog, and our in-house ticket router (see integration_requirements.md)

Please review and call out any must-haves vs nice-to-haves. My proposal: run a 2-week bake-off with Intercom and Zendesk (both paired with Gainsight for success workflows), score on reliability, dev integration effort, TCO (incl. message volume), and egress/costs.

Can Marissa own vendor costs/quotes and Connor lead the integration checklist? Laura — can you coordinate timeline with legal (I know renewal windows are tight)?

Short meeting tomorrow 10am PT to align? If not, reply with availability.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: support_rfp_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), vendor_scorecard.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

- I think the scoring should weight integration effort more heavily (we’ll eat engineering time otherwise).
- I have a contact at Intercom (Sam Zhao — sam.zhao@intercom.com) who can get us a tailored commercial and a doc with their data retention defaults. If we want Zendesk pricing, I can ask for a comparable enterprise worksheet from sales@zendesk.com.

I’ll collect the two commercial worksheets and populate the vendor_scorecard by EOD Friday.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-05-25T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Support stack sourcing — initial alignment

+1 on weighting integration effort. A few implementation flags from infra/eng perspective:

- Intercom: supports webhooks and large file attachments, but their webhook retry/delivery semantics are less configurable. We need guaranteed ordering for KB syncs.
- Zendesk: better ticket batching and bulk export APIs; slightly more ops work to build the real-time experience we have in Intercom.
- Gainsight: good for automated playbooks and aggregated health scoring; key ask is how we move event volume without blowing up their ingestion costs.

I attached integration_requirements.md with specific endpoints we need and expected QPS. If we do a bake-off, engineering can mock traffic to both vendors for a 72-hour window and report on latency and error profiles.

Connor
Principal SWE, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: integration_requirements.md (MD, 8KB)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Support stack sourcing — decision: run bake-off + procurement ask

Thanks everyone — short summary and asks:

- Decision: run a 2-week bake-off (T+7 start) between Intercom + Gainsight and Zendesk + Gainsight. Engineering to run traffic simulation during the second week.
- Marissa: get firm commercial worksheets from Intercom (Sam) and Zendesk (sales@zendesk.com) by 6/7 so we can score. Please include breakout for messages, seats, engagement automation, and any overage/ingest fees.
- Ben: please shepherd procurement steps (PO, SOC2 checks, legal redline playbook). Loop in Ben on vendor outreach — Ben, we need a recommended timeline for negotiation + 30-day lead time for any scheduled migration work.
- Laura: confirm legal availability for a quick review once we have the commercial worksheets.

I’m scheduling a 45-minute review on 6/12 3pm PT to review scorecard and decide next steps. Calendar invite coming.

Thanks — Tessa

P.S. Attached updated SOC2_request_checklist.docx (template we send to vendors).

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-09T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor process, redlines, and timeline

High-level procurement process and constraints:

- We require a SOC2 Type II report and the most recent penetration test summary before final signature. If vendors push back, we can accept an attestation plus a fixed window for delivery (30 days max) but that reduces negotiation leverage.
- Standard PO -> 30-day payment terms. For commercial inhibitors (e.g., high egress / message costs), we should negotiate annual caps.
- Legal will expect a short schedule (SOW + MSA) with Redwood-specific data handling clauses. Laura — you should expect to receive a redline request after 6/12 if scoring favors a vendor.

Proposed timeline:
- 6/07: commercial worksheets collected (Marissa)
- 6/08–6/10: engineering bake-off and scoring
- 6/12 3pm PT: scorecard review and vendor selection
- 6/13–6/20: procurement + legal negotiations (target signature by 6/25)

Attachments requested from vendors: SOC2_report.pdf (or link), data_retention_policy.pdf, SLAs for webhook delivery.

Ben
Ben Carter
Procurement Lead (acting)
Redwood Inference
